title: net_quality_bursts: one run of failed, unknown or missed probes in a connection-quality session
description: One row per run of consecutive lines of one source, probe and target sharing a condition, and per run of consecutive missed slots of one source. The provenance lists every line of the run. See docs/contracts/decoded-tables.md section 5.22.

kind.description: loss_burst: consecutive echoes to one target not answered; dns_failure_burst: consecutive failed queries to one server; probe_unknown: consecutive echoes whose outcome is unknown; link_down: consecutive readings not connected or not up; link_unknown: consecutive readings that could not be made; route_changed: consecutive readings on a changed default route; sampling_gap: consecutive missed slots of one source (not a loss).

source_id.description: The collector source whose samples file holds the line.

target.description: Fixed label of the probed address; null for a link reading. The gateway address itself never reaches a bundle.

count.description: Lines in the run. The seq span of a probe run can include missed slots, which are their own sampling_gap rows.

qpc_start.description: qpc_before of the first probe, or the slot_qpc of the first missed slot.

qpc_end.description: qpc_done of the last probe, or the counter reading that found the last slot missed.

start_utc.description: time_utc of the first probe; null for a sampling gap.

end_utc.description: time_utc of the last probe; null for a sampling gap.
